paragraph:
This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and baked data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**Answer.**
One NYC DOE school within 1,500 meters of 79-01 Broadway, Queens, is modeled to be inside the NYC DEP extreme stormwater scenario (2080 sea-level rise) [doe_school_exposure].

**Hazard Reader.**
79-01 Broadway, Queens, sits outside the empirical 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint [sandy_inundation]. 79-01 Broadway, Queens, sits in FEMA flood zone X, per NFHL FIRM panel 3604970207F, effective 2007 [fema_nfhl]. 79-01 Broadway, Queens, is outside the modeled flooding in the NYC DEP stormwater scenario (2.13 in/hr, 2050 SLR) [dep_moderate_2050].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
